classification_policy.universal_foundation: The smallest cross-vertical control and evidence spine required to bind any of the five recipes. It is intentionally smaller than the 31-block Digital Business OS recipe.
classification_policy.vertical_spine: A domain-defining state, authority or transaction block required to prove one overlay's distinctive value.
classification_policy.optional_enhancement: A useful shared or overlay capability that can be added after the representative foundry set proves composition and authority boundaries.
classification_policy.deferred: A high-risk, high-scope or currently gap-heavy capability excluded from the first foundry proof; this is not a rejection of eventual demand.

construction.why_smallest: The set includes the tenant/authority, shell, files, workflow, connector, evidence, admin, intake and delivery contracts, then one dependency-closed domain anchor per overlay. Marketing needs two anchors because its distinguishing proof requires both an untrusted client boundary and an approval/version boundary; the generic workflow engine alone cannot prove either surface.

dependency_closure.notes: Closure is defined against the hard edges needed by the selected anchors, not against every optional block in the five full recipes.

shape_probes.probe: Treat a connector/catalogue capability as an externally governed service boundary with tenant-safe identity and action receipts.
Treat a client-facing portal as a bounded external surface with scoped visibility and no internal operations leakage.
Bind a workflow/evidence engine to distinct Actionist-owned domain state and approval surfaces without letting a source system define product authority.

value_matrix.row_grain: one row per source_id + reuse_shape + recipe_id + block_id
value_matrix.comparison_scope: Compare rows only when reuse_shape, recipe_id and block_id are held constant; a repository is never assigned one universal value score.
value_matrix.reason_for_shape_specificity: The same repository may be valuable as an intact service, unusable as a transplant, and useful only as a generated pattern. Source identity, block semantics, host seam, authority, adaptation cost and evidence must therefore be evaluated per reuse shape.
value_matrix.unknown_policy: UNKNOWN is distinct from zero. Missing evidence lowers evidence completeness and blocks a shape-specific decision when a hard gate is unknown; it is never silently converted into a low score.

dimensions.question: How important is the named outcome to a real operator, team or customer?

anchors.0: No named outcome or purely cosmetic convenience.
anchors.1: Nice-to-have preference with no identified consequence.
anchors.2: Local efficiency or quality improvement with limited downstream effect.
anchors.3: Repeated workflow, SLA, throughput or margin concern.
anchors.4: Direct revenue, retention, cost, risk or customer-trust consequence.
anchors.5: Critical business, financial, safety, regulatory or continuity outcome.

dimensions.rule: Catalogue mention alone may establish a demand signal but not validated demand; retain the evidence class and denominator.

dimensions.question: Is the target block a cross-vertical foundation or a narrow overlay, and how broadly is it required by the hub recipes?
dimensions.rule: Use the map class as the semantic role and the canonical recipe count as requirement breadth. Do not infer source reuse breadth from the block's hub membership.

dimensions.question: How much of the workflow contract is evidenced by this source in the selected shape?

anchors.0: No workflow or only a name/metadata tag.
anchors.3: Trigger, data identity, states and named actor/authority.
anchors.4: The above plus exception behavior and source/provenance evidence.
anchors.5: The above plus negative path, recovery/read-back and verification receipt.

dimensions.rule: A README, popularity signal or broad category tag cannot fill a missing workflow facet.

dimensions.question: For the selected block and shape, in how many of the five recipes does this source have evidence-backed semantic fit?

anchors.1: One recipe has a source-read fit.
anchors.5: All five recipes have source-read fits.

dimensions.rule: Count only direct or otherwise explicitly evidence-backed semantic joins. Lexical tags, family labels and generic product descriptions do not count.

dimensions.question: Does the selected shape deliver a user-visible surface, engine leverage, or both?
dimensions.mode_rule: Preserve both subscores. Classify engine_only when user_visible_score<=1 and engine_only_score>=4; user_visible_and_engine when both scores>=4; otherwise use the nearest mixed mode with evidence.
dimensions.rule: Engine-only value is not a discount: a reliable service or adapter can unlock several visible workflows. Visible value is not sufficient: a surface without authority or state evidence is not reusable.

shape_profiles.high_value_when: The source supplies a complete capability behind a stable identity-bound API or event surface and can retain its own data authority.
A bounded user-visible surface can share host identity, navigation, settings and permissions without leaking donor ownership.
A product-defining subsystem can be owned deliberately with a bounded dependency closure and explicit migration/data authority.
A small, portable capability has high block or recipe breadth and does not drag an application-scale dependency closure into the host.
The source remains authoritative while the adapter provides typed identity, mapping, idempotency, provenance and safe read-back.
Observed behavior or interaction grammar can be reproduced without inheriting source code, while the resulting pattern remains tied to a tested contract.
A complete composition envelope has a data spine, authority model, variant delta and explicit missing blocks.
No source is better than a bounded custom implementation for the product-specific gap.

value_matrix.scoring_rule: Compute a shape-specific weighted index only for a fixed block_id + recipe_id + reuse_shape row after hard gates are known. Report dimension values, evidence completeness, costs and blockers alongside the index; never roll rows into a repository-wide score.
